image_prompt.text: A single large magical portal arch as the lobby's hero build, heroic medieval fantasy stonework scaled to dominate the courtyard and composed to be framed from the entrance gap and from the benches
The glowing magical gateway inside the arch, unmistakably readable as the way onward out of the lobby
An open congregating area on the flat stone paving around the arch, stone benches set along the walkway where players gather and wait rather than pass through
A central stone fountain with flowing water at the heart of the lobby courtyard
High stone perimeter walls ringing the whole lobby, broken by one open entrance
Wall-mounted torches with warm fire burning along the stone walls
Colourful cloth banners hanging from the walls
Flat stone-paved ground across the entire lobby, with every element sitting on the ground and nothing floating

layout_placement.text: Portal gate at the arch in the centre of the lobby, linking players out to the tower-defense match

notes: Prompt self-declares Tower Defense, but the space described is the lobby, not the battlefield — no enemy lane, no build zones, no core. Strategy cannot express a walled gathering courtyard, so Entertainment owns the shape and Strategy is named second; no Strategy option was picked.

water-body is the decorative central fountain; the CHECK should clear immediately — a shallow basin, nothing swimmable and no self-occluding volume.
Prompt states flat stone ground and 'everything sits on the ground, no floating objects': no terrain relief, no overhang, nothing tiered.
Style is heroic medieval fantasy; folded into the option texts rather than carried as a pick.
